title: Phaguna and a little cold
literal_meaning: Source-based provisional rendering: in Phaguna, the cold becomes slight.
explanation: The rhyme sits directly under the dictionary’s adjective meaning “slight.” A later sense means “double,” but substituting it would reverse this reading. Our reading keeps the smallness suggested by the local gloss and hears a brief seasonal observation. It does not turn the line into a forecast for every place or year.
meaning_odia: ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଅଳ୍ପ ପରିମିତ ବା ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ପରର ଅର୍ଥ ଦ୍ୱିଗୁଣ; ତାହା ଏଠି ବସାଇଲେ ପାଠ ଓଲଟିଯିବ। ଆମ ପାଠ ନିକଟର ଅର୍ଥକୁ ଧରି ଅଳ୍ପ ଶୀତର ଏକ ଋତୁସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ କଥା ଶୁଣେ। ଉତ୍ସର ଦୁଗ୍ଣ ଶବ୍ଦରୂପ ରଖି ଏହାକୁ ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ପାଠ କୁହାଯାଉଛି। ସବୁ ସ୍ଥାନ ବା ବର୍ଷର ପାଣିପାଗ ଏଥିରୁ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ହୁଏନାହିଁ।
english_summary: The adjacent source gloss guides a cautious reading of the seasonal rhyme.
odia_summary: ଋତୁର ଧାଡ଼ି ପଢ଼ିବାରେ ପାଖର ଉତ୍ସାର୍ଥ ସତର୍କ ପଥ ଦେଖାଏ।
